title: Weight Gain During Pregnancy
claims: Physical activity is healthy and safe for most pregnant women.
Pregnant women should talk to their health care provider about any physical activity restrictions.
Work up to or maintain at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity per week, which can be broken into smaller chunks.
Pregnancy weight-gain goals should be discussed with a health care provider.
